meta.title: An amendment copies the technical round and one price round, never lot rounds
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup cannot create a lot round or a second event raised from a PR, so the plan cannot amend both source states.

The available read-back fields cannot identify which copied stage is the last live technical round or verify that the auction is preferred over the RFQ for a normal amendment and that the RFQ is preferred for a PR amendment.
Only one amendment can be issued because no operation creates or selects the second PR-based event.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFP + RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited to both rounds; both open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer converts the pricing round into a live auction.
The buyer issues a new version of the event with the item uuid set to “…”, with the item type set to “event_group”.
As the buyer, read the event and check that Data check: “status” equals draft; Data check: “stages” has exactly 2 entries; Schema check: “stages › rfx mode” is not empty.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Data check: “status” equals draft; Data check: “stages” has exactly 2 entries; Schema check: “stages › rfx mode” is not empty.
